units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:10">Esth. R. to I, 2</cite>. Tanḥ. Vayesheb 2 <he>כשגלו ישראל מש׳ … בש׳ וכ׳</he> when the Israelites were exiled from Samaria, Sennaherib sent his servants and settled them in S. to raise taxes for the kings.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:3">Num. R. s. 10<sup>3</sup></cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Amos 6:2">Am. VI, 2</cite>) <he>זה ציון וש׳</he> ‘these kingdoms’ refers to Zion and Samaria (Judah and Israel); a. fr.
